environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo GraphQL server deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023). The signing key is stored as a PEM file at /etc/app/signing.key, readable by the application process (uid 1000). The container runs with default seccomp profile. /tmp is a standard tmpfs mount accessible to the application user. No process isolation beyond standard Linux user permissions. The application has CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH capability for legacy reasons. Kubernetes pod runs with `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30`.
